system.description:
Matches wheels for pace and needs less road, but steers like someone skating on a frozen pond.

Rise Above. Difficult terrain does not slow it, and it can travel across liquid surfaces as if on ground.

Slide About. Handling is slippery: every Control Test needs 2 additional raises to pass.
